key_insight: DeHNSSo-v2 extends nonlinear shear-flow stability analysis to compressible, body-fitted geometries while delivering approximately 10× speed-ups on DeHNSSo-v1 nonlinear test cases.
engineering_relevance: The open-source solver supports boundary-layer transition and flow-control studies involving complex surfaces, resonators, and compressibility effects.
method: Compressible formulation on general 2D curvilinear grids with automatic grid generation.
Linear-cost sparse assembly and reusable per-mode factorizations.
Newton pseudo-arclength continuation for high-amplitude nonlinear solutions.
evidence_signal: Validation covers linear boundary-layer instability at Mach 0.5–4.5, nonlinear breakdown at Mach 1.6, swept-wing crossflow against DNS, and modeled resonator interactions against experimentally validated simulations.
watch_item: The formulation uses two-dimensional body-fitted geometries; applicability to arbitrary fully three-dimensional geometries is not established by the abstract.
paper_title: DeHNSSo-v2: A compressible, curvilinear, and efficient extension of the Delft Harmonic Navier-Stokes Solver
